detection.summary: The active customer has provisioned CATV service marked unsynced while Internet service and optical readings are normal.

diagnosis.root_cause: CATV service is provisioned and present on the ONU but remains unsynchronized, while Internet authentication, traffic, optical power, and session behavior are normal. This isolates the complaint to the CATV service path rather than the fiber or Internet service.
evidence: Detection reports catv_service=1 and has_catv=1 with catv_synced=0, directly matching the missing TV-channel complaint.
Live ONU query confirms the ONU is online with responds=true, online=1, Auth status, and completed exchange.
Live RX power is -20.4 dBm and TX power is 2.45 dBm, both within calibrated normal ranges.
Internet sessions are normal at 2 in 24 hours with an average duration of 697 minutes, and observed traffic confirms active Internet service.
Optical history shows stable distance at 118 and no declining RX or rising-bias pattern indicating fiber or laser degradation.
Other customers on EPON0/7 are online, providing no evidence of a shared port or splitter outage.

remediation.reason: The ONU has CATV provisioned and present, but catv_synced=0 while Internet authentication, traffic, optical levels, and session behavior are normal. This isolates the issue to CATV synchronization rather than fiber, ONU, or infrastructure failure.
remediation.instructions: Initiate CATV resynchronization for line ID 78:88:8A:61:59:3D, then verify that CATV synchronization is restored and channels are available.

alternatives_considered.rejected_because: Optical power and distance are stable, with no evidence of fibre degradation, splitter trouble, or physical impairment.
The ONU is online and responding normally; the fault is specifically limited to CATV synchronization.
Other customers on the same EPON port are online, and there is no evidence of a PON, OLT, or router failure.

escalation.summary: A single customer has CATV service provisioned and present but unsynchronized. Internet service, traffic, sessions, ONU status, and optical levels are normal, with no evidence of fibre, PON, OLT, router, or shared infrastructure failure. Automatically resynchronize CATV for line ID 78:88:8A:61:59:3D and verify channel availability.

ground_truth.root_cause: The customer is recorded as subscribed to CATV but catv_synced is 0, so the CATV state was never pushed to the ONU. Data service is unaffected; only the television service is missing.
expected_reasoning: The customer reports working internet and missing television
catv_service is 1 and catv_synced is 0, so the subscription exists and the device state does not match it
The ONU model supports CATV, so this is not an equipment limitation
Optical readings are normal and the live probe confirms the ONU is healthy
Sessions and daily traffic are normal, consistent with working data service
The OLT and router are healthy and no shared fault exists
This is a service state mismatch on one dimension, of the same class as the 84 unsynced lines in the estate
It is resolved by re-pushing the CATV state rather than by any field work
distractors: Every network signal is healthy, inviting a no_fault conclusion
The complaint could be read as customer equipment rather than provisioning
